caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background with a faint rectangular border enclosing the composition. The chair is constructed of light to medium brown wood, with three horizontal, slightly curved back slats connecting two back posts, both of which have rounded tops. The seat of the chair is a woven material depicted in a muted yellow-tan color and rectangular in shape, supported by four legs that taper slightly towards the bottom. The front legs are connected by a horizontal stretcher, paralleled by two additional stretchers lower down, and two more stretchers connect the front and back legs on each side. The chair is angled to show both the front and the right side, giving a sense of depth. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Dining Room Chair
